'''Chapter 279''' is titled "Pirate Luffy vs. God Enel".

==Cover Page==
[[Ace's Great Blackbeard Search]], Vol. 7: "Ace Wakes".

Some time later, [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] recovers from his near-drowning, and finds [[Moda|his savior]] tending to the family cows.

==Short Summary==
[[Conis]] finally convinces the citizens to escape to the [[Blue Seas]]. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Enel]] begin to fight. Enel realizes that he cannot hurt Luffy, because Luffy is made of rubber.

==Long Summary==


[[Angel Island]]'s residents hastily to the cloud's end. They are asking the Militia's whereabout but [[Conis]] did not have the courage to speak of the tragedy. [[McKinley]] suddenly interrupt and guaranteed that the [[God's Guards|White Beret]] will find the Militia to safety and commanded the citizens to leave immediately. He actually knows that [[Enel]] was an evil person and the Birka tragedy must not repeat where Enel destroyed it six years ago. McKinley revealed that many people fought against Enel. For the sake of the citizens, White Beret betrayed the Militia to protect the island. Conis left and leave the evacuation to McKinley.

Enel demanded respect from [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] as he himself is a god but Luffy did not see him as a god. [[Aisa]] praised Luffy for his braveness. [[Nami]] tells Luffy to be careful and Enel stared coldly at her. Luffy felt angrier as Enel laughed on the fate of the Skypiean and Luffy dashed towards Enel and attacked Luffy with his lightning. Dumbfounded Luffy stands firmly, Enel launched second and third attack and still Luffy was unaffected, yet it annoys Luffy and responded with a punch and Enel evaded it. Nami thought that maybe it is because of his rubber body make him able to withstand Enel's lightning.

Luffy reattacked Enel and welcomes it as he proudly thought that physical attack will not harm him but it proves otherwise. Nami concluded that it because rubber nulls out electricity and Luffy became Enel's natural enemy.

==Quick Reference==

===Chapter Notes===
*[[Conis]] convinces the people of [[Angel Island]] to escape.
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] is discovered to be immune to [[Enel]]'s lightning attacks, due to being a [[Gomu Gomu no Mi|rubberman]]. Also, due to electricity being naturally unable to pass through rubber, Luffy can both touch and hurt Enel.
